ai_summary: Power Finance Corporation (PFC) reported a strong Q1 FY25, with consolidated profit after tax increasing 20% and the loan asset book exceeding Rs. 10 lakh crore, alongside significant improvements in asset quality with gross NPAs falling below 3%. However, Q1 disbursements were "slightly subdued" due to a major internal transformation exercise that temporarily slowed business operations, though management is confident in achieving full-year growth targets. Some state utility payment delays also led to additional provisioning, indicating minor asset quality pressures despite overall improvements.
